svg.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
svg.aria-label: The HTTP proxy is a privileged tenant-0 VM. It reaches VM A of tenant 2 and VM V of tenant abcd, and VM V can reply to it. VM A cannot reach VM V, because neither of them is privileged.

text.tspan: allowed when the tenants match, or either side is in privileged_vms
